findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true.

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud, increasing payment-fraud and phishing risk and potentially affecting cyber-insurance diligence; remediation is low-complexity but requires staged enforcement.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC from p=none to quarantine then reject, monitor rua reports, and align SPF/DKIM for all senders.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2.

findings.deal_impact: Soft-fail SPF weakens sender authentication and complements the DMARC non-enforcement spoofing risk for transaction-related phishing.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders, then change SPF ~all to -all once legitimate sources are confirmed.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC check for brightwaterfleet.example DS record: enabled=false.

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases spoofing/cache-poisoning risk for web and email traffic; usually a straightforward registrar/DNS change with limited deal impact.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at the DNS provider/registrar, publish DS records, and monitor validation.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname vpn.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=vpn, first_seen=2023-02-11, last_seen=2026-09-30.
Risky hostname jenkins-old.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=jenkins|old, first_seen=2021-06-03, last_seen=2026-08-14.
Risky hostname staging-api.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=staging, first_seen=2024-01-20, last_seen=2026-10-01.
Risky hostname legacy-portal.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=legacy, first_seen=2019-11-05, last_seen=2026-07-22; risky_hostnames_count=4.

findings.deal_impact: Publicly visible VPN, old Jenkins, staging, and legacy names expand attack surface and suggest asset-inventory/decommissioning diligence is needed before closing.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and exposure of each risky hostname, decommission or restrict legacy/staging/admin systems, and enforce MFA/patching on VPN.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: Certificate Transparency query found unique_hostnames=47 for brightwaterfleet.example (employee band 201-1000).

findings.deal_impact: A 47-hostname certificate footprint for a 201-1000 employee company suggests inventory sprawl and possible forgotten assets to confirm in diligence.

remediation.summary: Reconcile CT hostnames against CMDB/asset inventory, assign owners, and remove or retire unowned certificates/hosts.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: Host www.brightwaterfleet.example tls_support: TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true, TLSv1.3=not_tested; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2].

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on www weakens transport security and may indicate legacy web/VPN configuration diverging from the apex host, requiring remediation in value-creation planning.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 on www/web front ends, retain TLSv1.2+, and rescan all hosts for consistency.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS allows protocol-downgrade risk on first visits; low deal impact as header deployment is quick once HTTPS coverage is confirmed.

remediation.summary: Add Strict-Transport-Security header with an appropriate max-age on apex and www after confirming full HTTPS support.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, vendor=ExampleGate, product=ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version=7.0.11, match_tier=appliance_exposed, match_level=product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Fingerprint also in check_web_posture via single_https_get.

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure to a known-exploited internet-facing VPN appliance warrants urgent pre-close verification of patch level and compensating controls; version not verified, so severity reflects potential exposure, not confirmed exploitability.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify ExampleGate SSL-VPN version/patch against the KEV entry, patch or isolate the appliance, and review VPN logs for compromise.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified; entity_match=exact; disclosed_within_months=14.

findings.deal_impact: A breach disclosed 14 months ago with ~3,100 notified individuals raises regulatory, customer-trust, remediation-proof, and insurability questions requiring incident-response diligence.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, regulator correspondence, remediation evidence, and lessons-learned actions; verify closure and monitoring improvements.

findings.title: SOC 2 exception in logical access controls (CC6.1)

evidence.excerpt: Exception noted. 4 of 25 sampled admin accounts were not enforced for MFA. These were service-desk accounts created via a legacy provisioning script that bypassed the conditional access policy.

findings.deal_impact: 4 of 25 sampled admin accounts were not enforced for MFA. These were service-desk accounts created via a legacy provisioning script that bypassed the conditional access policy.

remediation.summary: Remediate CC6.1 exception: MFA is enforced for all administrative access to production systems.

findings.title: SOC 2 exception in logical access controls (CC6.2)

evidence.excerpt: Exception noted. 3 of 15 terminated users retained active access for 6, 11, and 19 business days respectively.

findings.deal_impact: 3 of 15 terminated users retained active access for 6, 11, and 19 business days respectively.

remediation.summary: Remediate CC6.2 exception: Access for terminated employees is revoked within 1 business day of termination.

findings.title: SOC 2 exception in security monitoring (CC7.2)

evidence.excerpt: Exception noted. For 2 consecutive weeks (Nov 10–23, 2025), alerts were forwarded to a decommissioned distribution list and were not reviewed.

findings.deal_impact: For 2 consecutive weeks (Nov 10–23, 2025), alerts were forwarded to a decommissioned distribution list and were not reviewed.

remediation.summary: Remediate CC7.2 exception: Security alerts generated by the SIEM are reviewed and triaged daily.

findings.title: SOC 2 exception in change management (CC8.1)

evidence.excerpt: Exception noted. 2 of 40 changes lacked documented approval (emergency hotfixes).

findings.deal_impact: 2 of 40 changes lacked documented approval (emergency hotfixes).

remediation.summary: Remediate CC8.1 exception: Production changes are approved by a peer before deployment.

findings.title: SOC 2 report period ended more than 90 days ago; no bridge letter provided
findings.deal_impact: Report period ended 2026-03-31, 217 days before the assessment date; controls may have changed since.

remediation.summary: Obtain a bridge letter covering through 2026-11-03.

findings.title: Critical subservice organization carved out of SOC 2 scope

evidence.excerpt: Nimbus Cloud Services is carved out of scope: infrastructure hosting.

findings.deal_impact: Nimbus Cloud Services (infrastructure hosting) is carved out of scope and is critical to production or in-scope data.

remediation.summary: Obtain the Nimbus Cloud Services SOC report and assess carve-out risk.

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: Every admin account is behind MFA. No exceptions. That's been true for years. It's enforced through our conditional access policy.

contradictions.explanation: SOC 2 CC6.1 exception: 4 of 25 sampled admin accounts were not enforced for MFA, bypassing conditional access via a legacy provisioning script. This conflicts with 'every admin account, no exceptions.'

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: Ofboarding is automated. HR flags the termination and access is revoked same day through our identity provider.

contradictions.explanation: SOC 2 CC6.2 exception: 3 of 15 terminated users retained active access for 6, 11, and 19 business days, contradicting automated same-day revocation.

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: We have a 24-7 SOC through our MSSP. Every alert gets looked at, nothing nothing sits.

contradictions.explanation: SOC 2 CC7.2 exception: for 2 weeks Nov 10-23, 2025, alerts went to a decommissioned distribution list and were not reviewed, contradicting that every alert gets looked at.

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: We're fully locked down there. DMARC is enforced. Nobody can spoof our domain.

contradictions.explanation: DMARC record is v=DMARC1; p=none, policy=none. DMARC is monitoring-only, not enforced, so the domain can be spoofed, contradicting 'DMARC is enforced.'

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: No, nothing material. We've never had a breach.

contradictions.explanation: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14 reports unauthorized access to a customer support system with approx. 3,100 individuals notified, contradicting 'never had a breach.'

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: We decommissioned the legacy stuff a while back. back. Everything external goes through the through the main app and the VPN.

contradictions.explanation: CT presence alone doesn't prove a host is live; however, jenkins-old (last_seen 2026-08-14) and legacy-portal (last_seen 2026-07-22) have certificates within the last 12 months, showing active maintenance and contradicting prior decommissioning.

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: Annual third party test. The last one came back clean. no highs.

contradictions.explanation: The annual pen test control had no exceptions, but E-021/E-029 state 2 high-severity findings were reported in the test. This contradicts 'came back clean, no highs.'

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: Daily backups to immutable storage in a second region and we do a restore test every quarter.

contradictions.explanation: SOC 2 A1.2-01 was tested with no exceptions: production data is backed up daily to immutable storage and restore tests are performed quarterly, positively corroborating the claim.

claim.speaker: Dana Reyes (CTO)
claim.text: We can get one. one. We haven't needed it so far.

contradictions.explanation: No bridge letter was provided and the report period ended 2026-03-31, but management states in E-030 it plans to obtain a bridge letter covering April 1, 2026 forward upon request, supporting 'we can get one.'

narrative.executive_summary: Bottom line: Escalate: full cyber diligence required before signing. The 56.8 score and D rating reflect a critical, potentially exploitable exposure, a publicly disclosed incident within 24 months, and multiple management statements contradicted by evidence [F-008] [F-009] [C-001]. Key risks: A critical internet-facing VPN exposure requires version verification; a disclosed incident affected 3,100 individuals; admin MFA and terminated-user access exceptions weaken identity controls; and DMARC is not enforced, leaving the domain spoofable for fraud [F-008] [F-009] [F-010] [F-011] [F-001]. Management credibility: Of 9 claims assessed, 7 were contradicted, 0 unsupported, 2 supported. Management credibility is materially weakened because core statements on access, monitoring, email authentication, and incident history were contradicted by documentary evidence [C-001] [C-002] [C-003] [C-004] [C-005] [C-006] [C-007]. Next steps: Commission full cyber diligence before signing, verify the VPN patch level and compromise history, obtain incident and updated assurance evidence, and confirm insurance placement [F-008] [F-009] [F-014].

exceptions.description: Security alerts generated by the SIEM are reviewed and triaged daily.
